_comment: "Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an arrow, put it FACE UP INTO YOUR ARSENAL with an aim counter." Two separate reasons this did nothing. REVEAL_TOP_DECK does not read a nested 'effects' list -- it stores the revealed cards under 'into' and returns -- so everything after the reveal was unreachable. And what was nested there was PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM, which moves a card OUT of the arsenal onto the bottom of the deck and defaults to the OPPONENT's arsenal: the exact opposite direction, on the wrong player. It was reached for because it was the only arsenal effect that existed; PUT_INTO_ARSENAL is the one this text needs, and heat_seeker_red needed it too.
